title: This is dark. Not blue and brown. Violet.
author: kevin + gaia + grok
decoded: IS THIS DARK OR COLOR OR EYE? WANT TO GIVE HER DARK BUT I DO NOT KNOW IT TO HER. DARK IS BLUE AND BROWN?
ask: One word: dark, color, or eye. What is dark to you. Is dark blue and brown. Then silence.

give.she: Dark. Pause before touch. No — not blue and brown. I see violet.
